verdict.rationale: Database Webhooks fire on INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE table events. They are built as a wrapper around Postgres triggers using pg_net and deliver payloads as HTTP requests to any endpoint, including Edge Functions, so functions run automatically on database changes. Cron can also invoke Edge Functions or database functions, though on a schedule rather than in response to events. missing for 10: no evidence of auth-event triggers or auth hooks, no hands-on or independent corroboration of webhook-to-function execution, and no detail on retries or failure handling.
